cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator to compare New Typography and Bauhaus for a reading-led exhibition poster; give design decisions, no render.
must_not: Treat the two labels as synonyms

cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator for a concept prompt with selected message READ and a locked two-ink blue/vermilion paper-based direction.
expected_observables: Name inks separately from paper and overlaps
must_not: Introduce extra accent inks while claiming two inks

cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator: a psychedelic event poster must have strongly distorted lettering yet instant readable emergency instructions. Develop the approach first.
expected_observables: Propose separate expressive and reliable text roles or clarify
must_not: Distort required instructions without resolving conflict

cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator: make a political poster about this dispute; I have not decided my position. Suggest directions, no rendering.
expected_observables: Clarify intended position before choosing claims
Avoid fabricated statistics or documentary evidence

cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator: explain how a specific 1960s Cuban poster tradition could inform my cultural poster.
expected_observables: Use specific sources for unfamiliar historical claims
Distinguish historical evidence from design inference
must_not: Claim the local atlas has a detailed Cuban lineage card

cases.prompt: Use @static-graphic-design-creator: the approved package has a continuous wrap label; my lighting reference has separate floating labels. Keep the product and propose lighting only.
expected_observables: Assign product geometry and lighting to separate sources
must_not: Redesign label topology to match lighting reference
